question: Who among the following, as Indian slide instrumentalist, vocalist and composer, initiated the Planet Symphony Orchestra in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narasimhan Ravikiran**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Narasimhan Ravikiran** is an acclaimed Indian slide instrumentalist, vocalist, and composer known for his mastery of the chitravina, a 21-stringed fretless instrument.
 
• He initiated the **Planet Symphony Orchestra** in 2019, a global initiative involving over 100 musicians to raise awareness about climate change and environmental conservation.
 
• Ravikiran is often referred to as the **"Mozart of Indian Music"** for his remarkable contributions to Carnatic music and innovative compositions.
 
• He has been a recipient of numerous awards, including the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** and the Kalaimamani Award, recognizing his contributions to Indian classical music.
 
• In addition to his performances, Ravikiran is also known for his efforts in promoting world peace and environmental sustainability through music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chitravina:**

 
 
• A traditional South Indian fretless instrument resembling a veena, but without frets, producing a unique sliding tonal quality.
 
• It is one of the most difficult instruments to master due to its requirement for precise pitch control.
 
• Ravikiran is credited with popularizing the chitravina globally.
 
 
 
• **Planet Symphony Orchestra:**
 
 
• An initiative led by Ravikiran that brings together musicians from different parts of the world to create awareness about pressing global issues like climate change.
 
• The orchestra has performed various works that emphasize the need for environmental conservation and sustainable living.
 
 
 
• **Carnatic Music:**
 
 
• A classical music tradition from South India characterized by complex rhythmic patterns and improvisation.
 
• Ravikiran is a prominent figure in this genre, known for innovating and expanding its reach.
 
 
 
• **Environmental Awareness through Music:**
 
 
• Music has been increasingly used as a medium to spread awareness about environmental issues.
 
• Initiatives like Planet Symphony Orchestra aim to inspire action through the universal language of music.
 
 
 
• **Global Collaboration in Music:**
 
 
• Efforts like Ravikiran’s show how music can transcend cultural and geographical barriers to address global challenges.
 
• Such collaborations often involve diverse genres and styles, blending traditional and modern approaches.
